study.question: Does explicit cross-field-gated activity volume add predictive utility when the incumbent latest-activity readout is retained, rather than replaced?
study.hypothesis: Observation: incumbent AUC .6201924719712801 exceeds every r0022 replacement: all-count .6199958748993758, newer-count .6198801989958771, all-rate/support .6198448340158094, newer-rate .6195055992431732. Those replacements removed the latest ordinal readout. Its ternary value saturates once a newer event exists. Provisional mechanism: multiplicity and latest-event order are complementary; preserving both can help where replacing either did not. Prior probe found 48.04% of supported coordinates had >1 newer event (first512 only). This is a feature-accessibility hypothesis, not proof of unique information, causal user intent, or novelty.
